heroHeadline: Day 747: Sheinbaum Cites 1.4% Growth, Says US Talks Good Despite Tariffs
heroSubtitle: On October 15, 2026, Sheinbaum said GDP grew 1.4% in H1, ordered a probe of CDMX police over the Oct 2 march, and discussed Cuautla security and Jalisco protest repression.
